profiles.Summary: Unturned is a lightweight, low-fidelity open-world zombie survival game built on Unity, and the Steam Deck handles it very comfortably — expect smooth 60 fps at medium-to-high settings with modest power draw. ProtonDB reporters rate it platinum with no significant Linux or Deck-specific blockers reported.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were found; profiles are estimated from the game's lightweight Unity engine, low PC minimum requirements (GTX 960-class or below), and the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU. On your first run, check performance in a busy town area — the game should be well within the Deck's capabilities, so start with Optimal and move to MaxPerformance if it holds steady.
